# ADR 0003: Pessimistic row locks in a consistent order

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Core banking ledger

## Context

Concurrent transfers from several service instances must not double-spend or deadlock.

## Decision

Lock the customer accounts involved with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE in id order in one query; lock internal accounts last.

## Consequences

Correct across any number of instances; no deadlocks. The fee-income account is a hot row at high volume (mitigate later by sharding fee accounts or posting fees asynchronously).

## Alternatives considered

Optimistic locking with retries (many retries under contention); in-memory locks (don't work across instances).
